description: Plain offers a GraphQL API that lets teams access and manage customer data, usage, and conversations.

evidence.claim: Plain provides a GraphQL API at https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1
Authentication uses an API key passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header
The API enables pulling customer lists, upserting records, retrieving usage and billing info, and fetching conversation data
API keys can be generated from Settings → API Keys in the Plain workspace, allowing self‑serve credential access
The existence of the API indicates that building integrations is possible
The API supports a wide range of actions across customer data, billing, and conversation retrieval, indicating broad coverage
